description: Manage learning in Degreed: users, courses and articles, completions, groups, assigned learning and pathways.

degreed_assigned_learning_completed_trig.description: Runs when someone completes learning that was assigned to them.

output.assignment: The record returned by the service

degreed_content_updated_trigger.description: Runs when content in your catalog is changed.

output.content: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_assigned_learning_trigger.description: Runs when learning is assigned to someone, as required or by a person.

output.assignment: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_certificate_trigger.description: Runs when someone adds a certificate to their Degreed profile.

output.certificate: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_completion_trigger.description: Runs when someone in your organization completes a piece of learning.

output.completion: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_content_trigger.description: Runs when a course, article, video or other content is added to your catalog.

output.content: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_group_trigger.description: Runs when a group is created in Degreed.

output.group: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_pathway_trigger.description: Runs when a pathway is created.

output.pathway: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_skill_rating_trigger.description: Runs when someone rates a skill: their own, a peer's or as a manager.

output.skillRating: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_user_skill_trigger.description: Runs when someone adds a skill to their Degreed profile.

output.userSkill: The record returned by the service

degreed_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when a user is added to your Degreed organization.

output.user: The record returned by the service

degreed_pathway_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a pathway is changed.

output.pathway: The record returned by the service
